subject: Draft Mutual Action Plan & Credit/Commit Clarification — Next Steps
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Sara Nolan <sara.nolan@finlytics.com>, Alex Park <apark@finlytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Draft MAP + credit/commit questions (post-call recap)

Hi Sara / Alex —

Thanks again for taking the call this morning. Quick recap and next steps from our side, plus I attached the first draft of the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) we discussed. Please review the milestones and responsibilities and let me know any edits.

Key asks from Finlytics we captured on the call:
- Target production pilot: Jan 2027 (4-week pilot, pilot SLA to be agreed)
- Preferred commit: 12-month reserved tier, starting low with ability to scale at month 3
- Procurement requires a one-time onboarding credit ask (they mentioned a 20% credit on month 1 consumption as a possible ask)

Open questions for your team to confirm:
1) Confirm whether the procurement credit request is an ask to be applied as a dollar credit or a usage-credit (tokens) on the first invoice.
2) Can you confirm which stakeholders need inclusion on the MAP for legal/finance sign-off? (Procurement email in CC?)
3) Finalize target close date — we captured 2026-12-15 as a hopeful date but happy to align to your internal timelines.

Attachments: mutual_action_plan_draft_v2.xlsx, license_term_sheet_v1.pdf

Proposed next steps:
- You to confirm credit type and any approval path by EOD Tue (23 Nov)
- Redwood to send a pricing summary + proposed commit tiers for exec sign-off by Wed (24 Nov)

If helpful I can run a 15-min alignment with your procurement contact tomorrow afternoon.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

From: Sara Nolan <sara.nolan@finlytics.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Park <apark@finlytics.com>, procurement@finlytics.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + credit/commit questions (post-call recap)

Thanks Mina — solid recap. A few clarifications from Finlytics procurement: 

- The credit we requested is a billing dollar credit to offset onboarding usage for month 1; percentage-based is fine (20% would be our ask), but procurement will need to see that reflected as a credit line item on the invoice rather than token adjustments.
- Stakeholders for sign-off: Procurement (procurement@finlytics.com), Head of Data (Sara Nolan), and Finance (alex.fin@finlytics.com). I'm looping Alex Park as finance lead.
- Target close: We are aiming for 2026-12-10 to align with budget cutoffs — can Redwood accommodate that?

We reviewed the MAP and added a small note to call out an integration dependency (SFTP access to our logging bucket) which is required by the pilot. That dependency will need to be resolved before week 1 of the pilot.

If you can provide a short exec-friendly pricing summary with committed tiers and the credit line item, that will speed approval.

Sara
Sara Nolan
Head of Data | Finlytics
sara.nolan@finlytics.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Sara Nolan <sara.nolan@finlytics.com>, Alex Park <apark@finlytics.com>, procurement@finlytics.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 13:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + credit/commit questions (post-call recap)

Looping Marissa for pricing/credit approval and exec context.

Summary of what we can propose now for the exec note:
- Recommended commit options (monthly equivalent):
  * Bronze: 50k token units / mo (month-to-month) — no credit
  * Silver: 250k token units / mo (12-month reserved) — 10% one-time onboarding credit applied to month 1 invoice
  * Gold: 500k token units / mo (12-month reserved) — 20% one-time onboarding credit applied to month 1 invoice + dedicated onboarding support (2 days)

We should confirm which commit Finlytics is leaning toward — Sara indicated wanting the 12-month reserved but starting small. If they pick Silver and ask for a 20% credit, that would likely require a higher commit (Gold) or exec sign-off for the additional credit percentage.

Ben — can you please advise whether legal needs an updated term sheet to reflect the credit as a line item? I attached a quick term sheet for legal to review (license_term_sheet_v1.pdf).

Next steps I propose from Redwood:
- Marissa to review proposed credit bands and either approve the Silver-credit swap or provide sign-off language for a one-time exec credit.
- Mina to confirm the integration dependency owner at Finlytics (SFTP access) so our engineering team can schedule work.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Head of Sales — Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Sara Nolan <sara.nolan@finlytics.com>, Alex Park <apark@finlytics.com>, procurement@finlytics.com
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 16:42:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Draft MAP + credit/commit questions (post-call recap)

Thanks everyone — I reviewed the MAP and the proposed credit/commit options. Executives are comfortable supporting a conditional one-time onboarding credit if the customer meets a clear commit band and we document it in the MAP and the invoice.

Decision (conditional):
- Approve a one-time invoice credit of $50,000 for Finlytics, contingent on signing a 12-month reserved commitment at the Silver tier (250k token units / mo) within the target close window.
- If Finlytics requests the 20% credit and signs the Gold tier (500k token units / mo), we can approve the higher credit value (equivalent to 20% of projected month 1 consumption) pending final legal review.

Action items and owners (update to MAP):
- Milestone: Pilot start (owner: Finlytics) — dependency: SFTP access provisioned (owner: Finlytics procurement / infra)
- Milestone: Pilot completion & evaluation (owner: Redwood PM) — deliverable: pilot metrics pack and recommended configuration
- Milestone: Contract execution (owner: Finlytics + Redwood Legal) — target close date: 2026-12-10
- Pricing & Credits: Marissa Cole (Redwood) to approve and Ben to draft the invoice line item language for legal

Please confirm acceptance of these conditions by EOD Mon (23 Nov) so we can lock in the credit and get legal the updated term sheet. Mina — please schedule the procurement sync with Sara / Alex for Monday.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
VP, Commercial Strategy | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
